context:
Goal: lower only the prices that are wrong, not every old listing.
Problem (money): N sets which listings get a suggested cut; too few days cuts prices early, too many leaves cards unsold.
Based on (measured): by age alone, 901 of 914 live listings pass 14 days, 745 pass 30, 383 pass 45, none pass 60.
The trigger fires only when the card is unsold N days AND priced above market, so the real counts are lower; that count is unmeasured.

options.label: 14 days
options.lose: Cuts prices on cards that may still sell at their ask.

options.gain: A month gives a card a fair chance first.
options.label: 30 days
45 days
options.lose: Cards priced over market sit six weeks unsold.

ref: pricing-suggest spec section 4b (unsold as a qualifier); list mockup notes, point 3
title: How many days without a sale makes a card unsold?
why: A month gives each card a fair chance, and the above-market test stops cuts on fair prices.
